research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Shiok Meats is engaged in the isolation and cultivation of muscle and fat cells from crustaceans. Their research focuses on developing renewable crustacean cell lines, which include primary muscle and/or fat cells. These cell lines are characterized by their ability to undergo multiple passages, enhancing their sustainability and potential for large-scale production. This work aligns with Shiok Meats' focus on cellular aquaculture and cell-based meat, advancing the field of sustainable seafood alternatives.

overview_description.description:
Shiok Meats is cellular aquaculture and cell-based meat company. With a mission to bring clean and healthy meats and seafood by harvesting from cells instead of animals. Shiok Meats brings cell-based crustacean meats that are animal-, health- and environment-friendly.

Shiok Meats was founded in 2018 and is headquartered in Central Region, Singapore.
